name: Rat
description: A small Gateless thief and eavesdropper who follows Kaya and Teyo and still mourns Hekara.

description_citations.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
description_citations.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat meets her friend Hekara on the Transguild Promenade and reports on tailing Ral Zarek to Nivix, where he and Niv-Mizzet had an exploding experiment.
timeline.quote: Something about a beacon being their only chance now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara receives Zarek's summons to activate the beacon and tells Rat to take the night off.
timeline.quote: It's now-or-never time.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Hekara leaves, calling Rat by her full name, and Rat wanders the city until dawn when Hekara does not show.
timeline.quote: She wasn't there. I waited, but she didn't come.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo materializes on the Promenade covered in sand, and Rat adopts him.
timeline.quote: And as a sand-covered boy materialized right in front of me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat learns Teyo is from Gobakhan and an acolyte of the Shieldmage Order and explains that he has planeswalked to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Teyo, I've a feeling you're not on Gobakhan anymore.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Teyo about the Living Guildpact Jace's absence and Vraska's assassination of Isperia.
timeline.quote: Mistress Vraska—she's the Golgari guildmaster—assassinated Mistress Isperia, the Azorius guildmaster.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat and Teyo arrive at Tenth District Plaza and find a new obelisk and pyramid crowned with dragon statues.
timeline.quote: Sometime—sometime very recently—it had risen out of the ground, displacing buildings and gardens and whatever else used to be there.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: A giant portal opens and splits the Embassy of the Guildpact, killing bystanders, and Bolas gloats from his pyramid.
timeline.quote: A gigantic portal—easily fifty yards tall—had opened up behind us, instantly decimating the Embassy of the Guildpact, sheering it right in half.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek and Kaya fight the Eternals and save civilians, while Rat and Teyo recover from their shock.
timeline.quote: Mistress Kaya said, "Run."

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo shields Kaya from a mineralized minotaur while Rat stabs it, and Zarek electrocutes it.
timeline.quote: He stood over Mistress Kaya, erecting a triangular shield of light to protect her and himself from the creature.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The raven-haired woman watches the planeswalkers and Rat fight, then leaves for the pyramid.
timeline.quote: her shaking her head in pity, if not disgust

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya tells Rat that Hekara is dead, devastating Rat.
timeline.quote: Hekara's dead,

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat, stunned by news of Hekara's death, stabs an Eternal about to kill Teyo, and Kaya takes Rat and Teyo with her.
timeline.quote: Furious, I leapt at it and stabbed it in the eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
timeline.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya leads Rat and Teyo across Ravnica toward Orzhova, saving people and telling them to shelter indoors, since Eternals do not enter buildings.
timeline.quote: The saving grace was that, for whatever reason, the Eternals weren't entering any of the buildings.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo, Kaya and Rat discuss the Gatewatch and Teyo admits he has killed only a spider.
timeline.quote: Never heard of 'Gatewatch' before today.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya's shortcut leads to a dead end, and Rat reveals the alley is a dead end as Eternals enter it.
timeline.quote: Another crop of Eternals had entered the mouth of the alley.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo expands his shield across the alley to hold the Eternals while Rat picks the lock of Krumnen's.
timeline.quote: I'll buy the time,

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Teyo and Kaya save Gan Shokta from a dying Eternal, and Rat reveals Gan is her father.
timeline.quote: That's Gan Shokta. My father.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: The Gruul, Izzet and Simic forces fight together, and the group meets planeswalkers Kiora and Samut, who frees dead Eternals by name.
timeline.quote: You are free, Eknet.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Jace mind-calls everyone to retreat and meet at the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: Meet us at the Azorius Senate. Now.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Kaya reaches Orzhova and asks her chief servitor to rally the Orzhov against Bolas.
timeline.quote: In an attempt to rally the Orzhov to fight Bolas and his Eternals

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: At the Senate House summit, Rat notes that most guilds are absent, and Rakdos blames the leaders for Hekara's death.
timeline.quote: Lord Rakdos blamed Master Zarek, Mistress Kaya, Miss Lavinia, and Mistress Vraska

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat learns Domri Rade is dead after his Spark was harvested and that Niv-Mizzet is dead.
timeline.quote: Turns out he was a Planeswalker and got his Spark harvested by an Eternal.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
timeline.quote: Vraska's vengeance was well earned!

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
timeline.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 May 2019.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

pages_say.description: A small, chatty, thieving Gateless girl born to the Gruul who tails Master Zarek for Hekara, adopts the newly arrived Teyo and fights the Eternals.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Old Friends and New" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 May 2019.

pages_say.description: A small, Gateless Gruul-born thief and daughter of Gan Shokta who grieves Hekara while fighting Eternals alongside Kaya and Teyo.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.
